Investing.com on 2 Nov gives the October Czech manufacturing PMI as 55.0, up from 53.5 in September, and InstaForex gives the same figure; the S&P Global release itself was not read.
Investing.com on 2 Nov gives the October PMI as 55.0, which is at or above 53.5, and InstaForex matches; the S&P Global release itself was not read.
